fields.Name: T211 - Developer Tools GraphQL Console Entity Template Insert
fields.Description: Exercises the metadata-driven entity/schema browser sidebar and its editor-template insertion (OnEntityOp), a separate code path from query execution and from schema introspection.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and choose the Admin app. Open the 'Developer Tools' section, then in its left sub-navigation click 'GraphQL Console'. If the History sidebar is not visible, click the 'History' toggle button to reveal the sidebar, then click the 'Entities' tab inside that sidebar. Type a common entity name (e.g. 'Users') into the entity search box, click the matching entity row to expand it, then click one of its operation buttons such as 'Run view' or 'Get by ID'. Success is the entity browser working: a filtered entity list appears, an entity expands to show operation buttons, and clicking one INSERTS a GraphQL query template into the editor (the editor is no longer empty). Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment - wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The GraphQL Console sidebar shows the Entities tab with a searchable, filterable list of entities
Expanding an entity reveals operation buttons (Run view / Get by ID) and clicking one populates the query editor with a generated query template
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
